comments.text: Turkmenistan is one of the most mysterious countries in Central Asia. 👀 What surprised you most, and would you ever visit Ashgabat? 💬 Share your thoughts below, and don’t forget to Like 👍 and Subscribe 🔔 for more travel documentaries. #Turkmenistan #Ashgabat #CentralAsia #TravelDocumentary

comments.author: @AmazingDiscoveriesTopUS
comments.text: From the golden Akhal- Teke horses to the mysterious Door to Hell, Turkmenistan is unlike anywhere else on Earth. Which of these incredible places would you most want to see in person?

replies.author: @UnseenWorldDocs_Us
replies.text: 🐎 The Akhal-Teke horses look unreal. Do you think seeing them in person would beat the Darvaza crater?

replies.author: @UnseenWorldDocs_Us
replies.text: 👋 Appreciate the wave! Would you rather see the white city or the Door to Hell in person?
